title: Coach, Not Crutch
body: Practicing with AI taught clear writing better than practicing alone (d = .38), with 74% fewer keystrokes.

title: AI Suggestions Homogenize Writing
body: AI autocomplete nudged Indian writers toward Western styles, flattening the cultural nuance in their writing.
credit: Paola J. Sullivan, Mariana G. Rebello, and Sofia Villanueva

title: Whose Voice Is It Anyway?
body: GPT detectors flagged most non-native English essays as AI-written: one of three papers on who owns a text.
